title: Release nasaweather 0.1.1
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [x] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_nasaweather.html)
* [x] `usethis::use_news_md()`
* [x] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [x] `usethis::use_github_links()`
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [x] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [x] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [x] Update `cran-comments.md`
* [x] `git push`

Submit to CRAN:

* [x] `usethis::use_version('patch')`
* [x] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [x] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [x] Accepted :tada:
* [x] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [x] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
* [x] `usethis::use_news_md()`

title: "borders" dataset is corrupted
description:
When trying to load the "borders" dataset from the package, R says:
`glimpse(borders)`
`Error in 'group_data()':`
`! '.data' must be a valid <grouped_df> object.`
`Caused by error in 'validate_grouped_df()':`
`! Corrupt 'grouped_df' using old (< 0.8.0) format.`
`ℹ Strip off old grouping with 'ungroup()'.`
`Run 'rlang::last_trace()' to see where the error occurred.`

title: storms data shows wrong description in help
description:
library(nasaweather)
help(storms)

Wrong description shown:
"Tropical cyclone tracks through the Atlantic Ocean, Caribbean Sea and Gulf of Mexico from 1995 to 2005"

Right description should indicate correct years:
Dataset includes data from 1995 to 2000.
